        break
    all_orders.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Determine current calendar year

# Filter orders in this year
from datetime import datetime as dt
orders_in_year = []
for o in all_orders:
    try:
        created = dt.fromisoformat(o['created_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        created = None
    if created and created.year == year:
        orders_in_year.append(o)

print('orders_in_year', len(orders_in_year))
